assumptions: The codon usage table is the organism's.
limits: Designs the oligos; the yield of all-sites-mutated clones is not predicted.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which one-reaction QCLM primers make several mutations at once, with codons from an organism's usage table?

description: Design QCLM (quick-change lightning multi-site) oligos: one primer per mutated site, all annealing in one reaction, with the codons drawn from an organism's usage table. A design/write.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

cds.description: the CDS nucleotide sequence, in frame from the start codon.

codon_usage_frequency_threshold.description: discard synonymous codons rarer than this fraction in the chosen organism.

dntp.description: total dNTP concentration, which chelates magnesium and so lowers the effective Mg²⁺. In mM. Advanced.

five_end_flank.description: explicit 5' context. Left empty, 60 bp is read off the open record either side of the CDS. Advanced.

five_end_size_weight.description: score weight on 5'-lead length deviation. Advanced.

gc_content_weight.description: score weight on GC overflow. Advanced.

gc_value_set.description: which published GC-formula parameter set the melting temperature is computed under. Values: QuickChange (QuikChange (the kit manufacturer’s own formula)), Chester_1993 (Marmur-Doty (Chester & Marshak 1993)), Schildkraut_1965 (Schildkraut & Lifson 1965 (Marmur-Doty + log[Na⁺])), Primer3 (Primer3Plus product Tm (Biopython’s default set)), Ahsen_2001 (von Ahsen 2001 (accuracy against ease of use)). Advanced.

hairpin_temperature_weight.description: score weight on hairpin Tm. Advanced.

mg.description: magnesium concentration — the term the Owczarzy corrections are most sensitive to. In mM. Advanced.

min_five_end_size.description: bases between the 5' terminus and the first mutated codon, minimum. In nt. Advanced.

min_gc_content.description: lowest oligo GC accepted. In %. Advanced.

min_temperature.description: lowest Tm threshold the growth scan sweeps. In °C.

min_three_end_size.description: bases between the last mutated codon and the 3' terminus, minimum. In nt. Advanced.

mutation_coverage_weight.description: score weight on how many of the requested aminos the design actually delivers — upstream's dominant term. Advanced.

mutations.description: the substitutions, comma- or space-separated, as [WT][pos][MUT] — e.g. "E42L, E42W, K107M". Several entries at one position are ONE site delivering several aminos.

na.description: sodium concentration the salt correction is computed for. In mM. Only applies when gc_value_set is Schildkraut_1965 or Primer3 or Ahsen_2001. Advanced.

non_overlapping_primers.description: forbid oligos from overlapping each other. Upstream ranks only the LAST split's solutions with this on (a reproduced bug, see the port header). Advanced.

organism.description: codon-usage table the synonymous choice is drawn from.

precision.description: decimal places the reported Tm is rounded to. In dp. Advanced.

primer_dimer_temperature_weight.description: score weight on dimer Tm. Advanced.

primer_size_weight.description: score weight on oligo length deviation. Advanced.

seed.description: seed for the codon draw. The same seed and the same request give the same oligos; change it to re-roll.

temp_range_size.description: width of the acceptable Tm window around the reaction temperature. In °C. Advanced.

temp_threshold_step.description: step between Tm thresholds tried. In °C. Advanced.

temp_weight.description: score weight on Tm deviation. Advanced.

three_end_flank.description: explicit 3' context, the partner of `five_end_flank`. Advanced.

three_end_size_weight.description: score weight on 3'-tail length deviation. Advanced.

tris.description: Tris concentration. In mM. Only applies when gc_value_set is Schildkraut_1965 or Primer3 or Ahsen_2001. Advanced.

use_degeneracy_codon.description: collapse a site's codons into one IUPAC-degenerate codon (upstream's default). Off, each amino gets its own oligo.

use_primer3.description: apply primer3 hairpin / homodimer / heterodimer penalties. Advanced.

name: design_multisite_primers

failureCount.description: constraint breaches in the winning solution (0 = every oligo inside its limits)

fullSequence.description: the construct the oligo coordinates are on: flank + CDS + flank

mutationCoverage.description: fraction of the requested amino acids the design actually delivers, 0–1

oligos.description: one oligo per site, with its span, Tm, GC and the degenerate codons it installs

reactionTemperature.description: the ONE annealing temperature the winning solution is built for

seed.description: the seed this design was drawn with — change it to re-roll, keep it to reproduce
